title: Book Three · Chapter 190: The Early April Replies
story:
Early in April, Ronan has completed thirteen working weeks.

His thirteenth Friday payment brings his work money to four hundred and fifty-nine yuan. Two weeks of the agreement remain.

Today he and Anna meet to write their signed answers.

Ronan has read the coastal offer with both parents. The money already saved can cover his first-term plan. They have also listed the second term and the remaining unknown costs.

He has not added the last two weeks' pay to the saved amount.

Anna has checked her family's plan too. She takes out her reply form and writes the course name carefully.

“Not the coast,” she says as Ronan looks over.

“I know.”

She smiles and passes him his own form.

He signs the answer accepting his place. Anna signs hers. He writes a second copy for his own folder. They check the return addresses and the two May deadlines once more.

That afternoon, they post the replies. Each pays their own postage from other personal spending money. Neither reply needs a class payment yet.

Outside, Anna takes his hand. They walk to the river path and sit above the water, away from the busy road.

For a while, they watch the light move beneath the bridge.

“I want to know your ordinary days,” she says.

“Even the very ordinary ones?”

“Those too.”

Ronan thinks about the counter and his lunch walk.

“At first, a letter each week?”

“Yes. We can tell each other if the plan needs to change.”

He nods. The letters will take time. They both know that now.

“And visits?” he asks.

Anna looks down at their hands.

“When we know our free days. And the real costs then.”

“I want to try.”

“Me too.”

She leans against him. Ronan holds her close while a boat moves slowly beyond the bridge.

They stay until the wind grows cooler. On the way back, Anna asks what his most ordinary day contains.

“Breakfast,” he says.

“Good. Start there.”

He laughs and tells her about Dad's burnt piece of bread from that morning. She tells him her mother always notices the last cup on the table.

At the corner, Ronan kisses her before they separate. He keeps her hand for a moment afterward, then lets her go toward her own home.

His signed answer is in the post. At home, he puts the copy beside the offer and prepares his clean work shirt for Monday.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

accept＝接受一个已提供的机会；deadline＝截止日期；ordinary＝平常的；contain＝包含、有。

## 理解问题

1. 确认回函什么时候实际寄出？它们是否带了学费，末两周工资是否已入账？
2. 两人怎样约定通信和尝试会面？有没有许下每周必见或终身同城？

## 读句子

**His signed answer is in the post.**

拆开看：His signed answer / is / in the post.

他签名接受名额的答复／已经／寄在路上。
